info.title: Job Posting
info.description:
We are making updates to our collections. If you run into any issues pulling the latest changes, simply fork the collection again.

LinkedIn's Job Posting API enables authorized third parties such as clients, ATS systems, and Job Distributors to post jobs directly to LinkedIn on behalf of customers. This guide details on how to integrate with LinkedIn's Jobs Posting API.

The use of these APIs is restricted to developers approved by LinkedIn. Please reach out to your LinkedIn Relationship Manager or Business Development contact as you will need to meet certain criteria and sign an API agreement with data restrictions in order to use this integration.  
If you are not yet a LinkedIn Talent Solutions Partner, please complete the [LinkedIn Talent Solutions Partner Request Form](https://business.linkedin.com/talent-solutions/ats-partners/partner-application).

post.description:
By using this API, Customer can create `BASIC` Jobs. To know more please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/job-posting-api-schema#foundation-schema)

By using this API, Customer can create `BASIC` Jobs with `workRemoteAllowed` as `True`. Hence Jobs posted through this API will be Remote enabled Job. To know more please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/job-posting-api-schema#foundation-schema)

By using this API, Customer can create `BASIC` Jobs with `workRemoteAllowed` as `True`. Hence Jobs posted through this API will be Remote enabled Job. To know more please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/job-posting-api-schema#foundation-schema)

This API Call is for creating Promoted Jobs by mentioning `listingType` as `PREMIUM`. `Contract URN` is mandatory field for this call. Customer can include `posterEmail` and `showPosterInfo` as field Parameter. Please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/job-posting-api-schema#promoted-jobs-extension-schema)

This call is for Syncing PUBLIC Jobs to LinkedIn from ATS. `availability` field set to `PUBLIC`. Please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/job-posting-api-schema#recruiter-system-connect-extension-schema)

This call is for Syncing PUBLIC Jobs to LinkedIn from ATS. `availability` field set to `PRIVATE_TO_ATS_INTEGRATION`. Please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/job-posting-api-schema#recruiter-system-connect-extension-schema)

In order to update a simple job posting, you can just re-post the job with any changed information and `jobPostingOperationType` field value set as `UPDATE` .Please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/update-renew-jobs)

To renew a job, re-post it with `jobPostingOperationType` field as `RENEW` and no other changes. The renewal operation extends the expiration of job posts by 30 days. .Please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/update-renew-jobs)

There are two alternate ways to renew job postings:

Close previous jobs, and re-post jobs without any changes
Publish new jobs with different `externalJobPostingId`

To close a job, re-post the job using same `externalJobPostingId` value, but set jobPostingOperationType to `CLOSE`.Please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/close-jobs)

The maximum number of jobs which can be submitted during one batch call is 100. If you would like to submit more than 100 jobs at a time, please group your jobs in to collections of 100 and make multiple batch calls in sequential order. To know more, please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/create-jobs#sample-request-for-basic-jobs)

By using this API, Customer can create `BASIC` Jobs with `onsiteApplyConfiguration`.To know more , please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/sync-jobs-onsite-apply#job-posting-field-schema)

This API Call is for creating Promoted Jobs by mentioning `listingType` as `PREMIUM`. `Contract URN` is mandatory field for this call.To know more,Please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/sync-jobs-onsite-apply#sample-request-body)

By using this API, Customer can create `BASIC` Jobs with `onsiteApplyConfiguration` and `workRemoteAllowed` set to `TRUE`.To know more , please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/sync-jobs-onsite-apply#job-posting-field-schema)

In order to update a job posting, you can just re-post the job with any changed information and `jobPostingOperationType` field value set as `UPDATE` .Please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/sync-jobs-onsite-apply#apply-connect-jobs-lifecycle)

In order to update a job posting, you can just re-post the job with any changed information and `jobPostingOperationType` field value set as `RENEW` .Please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/sync-jobs-onsite-apply#apply-connect-jobs-lifecycle)

In order to update a job posting, you can just re-post the job with any changed information and `jobPostingOperationType` field value set as `CLOSE` .Please refer [here](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/sync-jobs-onsite-apply#apply-connect-jobs-lifecycle)

    {
      "integrationContext": "urn:li:organization:{{company_id}}",
      "companyApplyUrl": "https://careers.yourcompany.com",
      "externalJobPostingId": "{{external_job_posting_id}}",
      "jobPostingOperationType": "CREATE",
      "title": "Software Developer in Test",

      "listedAt": {{$timestamp}}000,
      "location": "Sunnyvale, California",
      "categories": [
          "rsch"
      ],
      "industries": [
        "urn:li:industry:55"
      ],
      "skillsDescription": "Lorem Ipsum is simply dummy text",
      "companyJobCode" : "company_{{external_job_posting_id}}",
      "employmentStatus": "FULL_TIME",
      "experienceLevel": "EXECUTIVE",
      "trackingPixelUrl": "http://www.trackingpixellocation.com/pixel.gif",
      "listingType": "BASIC"
    }
  ]
}
